name: Golf shoes

name: Mild steel sabatons
description: A pair of jointed steel foot covers, the lames sliding over each other as the foot flexes, strapped on over a shoe.
notes: A standing pair of foot covers over a shoe that is not there, each 280 mm long and 110 mm wide, toes on +z: six lames stepping down the instep to a pointed toe cap, a heel cup with an open ankle ring showing the leather lining, and a leather strap under the arch buckled on the outer side. The box spans the hollow where the shoe goes and the gap between the pair. Sabatons are worn on an outer layer over other footwear; no outer foot slot exists, so this takes feet and cannot be worn over shoes until one does. The xl_ size shares this model.
